Code quality review in the `imp` Python project. Work from: /home/jpoimboe/imp
DESCRIPTION: Atomic cutover from a static `context: fresh|resume` step flag to the navigation-time `resume:` verb. Deleted the `Context` literal, `Step.context` field, `_parse_context` (loader), and `_v_agent_only_fields` (validators) plus call sites; simplified the executor keep-decision to `keep = is_resume` and refreshed its docstring/comment; migrated the bundled workflow.yaml back-edges to `resume:` (leaving phase jumps as goto:); migrated all embedded-context tests; refreshed the runner comment; added the S1 pause→reload regression test.
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: Task 7 from docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-30-resume-action-verb.md
- Are the deletions clean (no orphaned imports, no now-dead helpers, no dangling references to removed symbols)? Check for unused imports left behind in types.py/loader.py/validators.py after the deletions (e.g. `Literal` if `Context` was its only user).
- Is the executor's refreshed docstring + keep-decision comment accurate and clear now that coexistence is gone?
- Is the S1 test well-structured and its self-contained runner justified (it needs per-invocation pause-then-succeed state)? Is the assertion sequence (PAUSED → persisted marker → COMPLETED → [False,True,True]) clear?
- Are the workflow.yaml and test migrations clean and consistent (resume: for back-edges, goto: for phase jumps)?
- Any clean-code/maintainability concerns from THIS change?
Pay special attention to ORPHANED CODE after deletions: run `rg` to check whether `Literal` is still used in types.py, whether any import in loader.py/validators.py became unused, and whether any other code referenced the deleted symbols.
Do not flag pre-existing code unrelated to this change or request scope expansion. Return: Strengths, Issues (Critical/Important/Minor), Assessment (Approved / Changes requested).
